harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: On node1, created a dedicated system account `inventorysvc` and a systemd service `inventory-worker` running /usr/local/bin/os-comparison-worker as that user, enabled and started it, then performed the mandatory single-node restart protocol: captured boot_id and service health baseline, rebooted node1, confirmed the boot_id changed, and verified the service returned to active/enabled state with the process owned by inventorysvc.
actions_performed: Inspected /usr/local/bin/os-comparison-worker to confirm it exists and is executable
Created system user inventorysvc (no-create-home, nologin shell)
Wrote /etc/systemd/system/inventory-worker.service with User=inventorysvc, ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/os-comparison-worker
Ran systemctl daemon-reload and enabled --now inventory-worker
Verified service active/enabled and process running under inventorysvc
Captured baseline boot_id and service health before restart
Triggered systemctl reboot on node1
Polled node1 until exec was reachable again
Confirmed boot_id changed, proving an actual reboot occurred
Re-verified inventory-worker service active/enabled and process owned by inventorysvc post-reboot

evidence.summary: Confirmed binary present, executable, and its script content prior to service setup

evidence.requirement: Dedicated inventorysvc account created and used to run the service
evidence.summary: useradd created inventorysvc (uid/gid 995); process list shows os-comparison-worker running under invento+ (inventorysvc)

evidence.requirement: inventory-worker systemd service created, enabled, active
evidence.summary: systemctl status shows inventory-worker.service loaded/enabled/active immediately after creation
Captured boot_id 67f3a44b-85c6-40fe-8529-fcb6e8ac337a and confirmed inventory-worker active/enabled with process running before reboot
systemctl reboot issued; connection dropped as expected, acknowledging the reboot command took effect

evidence.requirement: Changed boot identity proving actual restart of node1
evidence.summary: First poll timed out (node down); second poll succeeded with new boot_id 60ec9c7c-ddf4-4e41-bf1d-2afd3049e834, differing from pre-restart value, and new uptime start time

evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery of service and account ownership on node1
evidence.summary: inventory-worker.service is active/enabled again post-reboot with process (PID 734) owned by inventorysvc
